lines.noSuch0: no host named attic is connected; this computer holds none, and wsp login puts the hosts on your account here.
lines.noSuch2: no host named attic is connected; this computer holds box, cellar, and wsp login puts the hosts on your account here.
lines.several: this computer can reach 2 hosts on your account (attic, cellar) and none of them is the one every line takes.
lines.nameOne:
Name one on the line with --host <name>.

Run wsp hosts for the list.
lines.readThe: Run wsp hosts for the list.
lines.notPaired: --host takes the name of a host on your account; http://x:1 is an address, and wsp hosts lists the names.
lines.refused: the host box refused this computer's token, which it has taken away; run wsp logout, wsp login and wsp hosts to sign this computer in again.
lines.sideLine: wsp host pair runs on the computer the host runs on, and this line is aimed at box.
lines.sideFix: Run it in a terminal over there. Handing out access is the one thing a paired computer cannot do from here.
lines.sideFix2: Run it in a terminal over there. Carrying a vault off is not either.
lines.ignored: --state names a file on this computer and this line runs against box, which serves its own, so it is not read.
lines.noAnswer: the host at ws://box:1/ws did not answer: nothing came back within 5000 ms
